items.title_zh: 美国宇航局公布“邪眼”星系的惊人图像，引发互联网敬畏
items.title_en: NASA unveils stunning image of 'evil eye' galaxy, sparking internet awe
items.summary_zh: NASA 分享了哈勃太空望远镜 2008 年拍摄的“邪眼”星系的迷人图像。“邪眼”星系也称为梅西耶 64 (M64)，位于后发座星座。它有一个发光的黄色核，周围环绕着蓝色和紫色的点。该星系的显着特征是一条暗色尘埃带掩盖了其明亮的核心。
items.summary_en: NASA shares captivating image of 'Evil Eye' galaxy taken by Hubble Space Telescope in 2008. 'Evil Eye' galaxy, also known as Messier 64 (M64), is located in Coma Berenices constellation. It has a luminous yellow nucleus surrounded by blue and purple dots. The galaxy's distinctive feature is a dark band of dust concealing its brilliant core.

items.title_zh: 千禧一代哀叹黑色星期五促销活动在社交媒体上引起轩然大波
items.title_en: Millennials bemoan lackluster Black Friday deals in social media uproar
items.summary_zh: 在一段病毒式传播的 TikTok 视频中，千禧一代安东尼·科兹 (Anthony Koz) 发表了热情洋溢的长篇大论，声称曾经惊心动魄的黑色星期五已经失去了光彩，观看次数达到了惊人的 1700 万次。 “黑色星期五已经成为一种侮辱，”科兹沮丧地喊道，并感叹曾经定义购物假期的令人肾上腺素激增的折扣的消失。在怀旧的评论中，他回忆起过去几年的混乱场景，当时令人瞠目结舌的销售量值得争吵。
items.summary_en: In a viral TikTok video, millennial Anthony Koz unleashed a passionate tirade, claiming that the once-thrilling Black Friday has lost its luster, garnering a staggering 17 million views. "Black Friday has become an insult," Koz exclaimed in frustration, lamenting the absence of the adrenaline-pumping discounts that once defined the shopping holiday. In his nostalgic critique, he reminisced about the chaotic scenes of past years when jaw-dropping sales were worth the brawls.

items.title_zh: “至少他们不会在半决赛中输给印度”：巴基斯坦几乎无缘世界杯的模因爆发
items.title_en: 'At least they'll not lose to India in semis': Memes erupt with Pakistan all but out of World Cup
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦面临着进入世界杯半决赛的几乎不可能完成的任务。他们必须以 287 分的优势击败英格兰队，或者以 284 球的优势追赶目标。英格兰队在九场比赛中取得三场胜利，也希望确保进入前八名。新西兰队很可能锁定第四个半决赛席位，与印度队展开对决。
items.summary_en: Pakistan is facing a near-impossible task to secure a spot in the World Cup semifinals. They must defeat England by a margin of 287 runs or chase the target with a margin of 284 balls. With three wins from nine games, England is also looking to secure a place in the top 8. New Zealand is likely to lock the fourth semifinal spot, setting up a potential showdown with India.

items.title_zh: 巴西影响者凡妮莎·曼奇尼 (Vanessa Mancini) 因严重心脏病去世，享年 41 岁
items.title_en: Brazilian influencer Vanessa Mancini dies at 41 from massive heart attack
items.summary_zh: 病毒新闻新闻：41 岁的巴西网红瓦妮莎·曼奇尼 (Vanessa Mancini) 因富有感染力的快乐和幽默而闻名，她的过早去世令她的 30,000 名社交媒体感到震惊。
items.summary_en: Viral News News: Vanessa Mancini, a 41-year-old Brazil influencer known for her infectious happiness and good humor, met an untimely demise that shocked her 30,000 soc.

items.title_zh: 今年十一月感恩的 20 种方式
items.title_en: 20 Ways To Give Thanks This November With Gratitude
items.summary_zh: 表达感恩的方式有很多种，十一月感恩节是最佳时机。使用这些方式来表达感激之情。为除了自己以外的所有人做事的人带晚餐。您还可以赠送零食篮、自制美食或礼品卡到他们最喜欢的吃饭地点。
items.summary_en: There are so many ways to give thanks and November, the month of Thanksgiving, is the perfect time. Use these ways to show gratitude. Bring dinner to someone who does things for everyone but themselves. You could also give a snack basket, a homemade treat or a gift card to their favorite place to eat.

items.title_zh: 安杰洛·马修斯成为第一位被暂停的国际板球运动员，表情包爆发
items.title_en: Memes erupt as Angelo Mathews becomes first international cricketer to be timed out
items.summary_zh: 在世界杯对阵孟加拉国的比赛中，斯里兰卡选手安吉洛·马修斯成为第一位“暂停”的国际板球运动员。马修斯因头盔带问题而面临延误，并要求更换，导致他提出“暂停”解雇的上诉。场上官员根据规则宣布马修斯“暂停”，引发了球员、评论员和球迷对这一不寻常的解雇的争论。第25局斯里兰卡队当时的比分是135-4
items.summary_en: In a World Cup match against Bangladesh, Sri Lanka's Angelo Mathews became the first international cricketer to be "timed out." Mathews faced a delay due to issues with his helmet strap and requested a replacement, leading to an appeal for a "time-out" dismissal. The on-field officials declared Mathews "timed out" according to the rules, sparking a debate among players, commentators, and fans about the unusual dismissal. Sri Lanka's score at the time was 135-4 in the 25th over.

items.title_zh: 米娅·哈利法 (Mia Khalifa) 发布了艾米·舒默 (Amy Schumer) 与亚洲·杰克逊 (Asia Jackson) 就以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突进行的激烈交锋
items.title_en: Mia Khalifa posts Amy Schumer's heated exchange with Asia Jackson over Israel-Palestine conflict
items.summary_zh: 米娅·哈利法和艾米·舒默等名人因其对以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的评论而在社交媒体上遭到强烈反对。哈利法在将哈马斯称为“自由战士”后失去了与《花花公子》的播客合同，而舒默则因指责新闻媒体在没有适当事实核查的情况下将加沙医院爆炸事件归咎于以色列而受到批评。哈利法和舒默之间的 Instagram 消息交换被疯传，促使哈利法重新发布评论支持
items.summary_en: Celebrities such as Mia Khalifa and Amy Schumer have faced backlash on social media for their comments on the Israel-Palestine conflict. Khalifa lost her podcasting contract with Playboy after referring to Hamas as "freedom fighters," while Schumer was criticized for accusing news outlets of blaming Israel for a Gaza hospital bombing without proper fact-checking. An Instagram message exchange between Khalifa and Schumer went viral, prompting Khalifa to repost comments supportive of Palestinians.

items.title_zh: 球迷们嘲笑巴基斯坦队，普罗蒂亚斯队击败新西兰队，让巴基斯坦队保持半决赛的希望
items.title_en: Fans troll Pakistan as Proteas beat Kiwis to keep Pak's semi-final hopes alive
items.summary_zh: 南非队在世界杯比赛中以 190 分的优势击败新西兰队。德科克打进了本届赛事的第四个百分球，范德杜森打进了第二个进球，帮助南非队以 357 比 4 的总比分领先。新西兰队在追赶中举步维艰，最终以 167 名出局。这场胜利让南非队登上了积分榜榜首，也让巴基斯坦队保住了半决赛的希望。
items.summary_en: South Africa dominated New Zealand in their World Cup match, winning by 190 runs. De Kock scored his 4th century of the tournament and van der Dussen hit his second, helping South Africa reach a commanding total of 357-4. Kiwis struggled in their chase, collapsing to 167 all out. The victory moved South Africa to the top of the standings and kept Pakistan's semi-final hopes alive.

items.title_zh: 马克扎克伯格和家人万圣节变身霍格沃茨偶像温暖人心
items.title_en: Mark Zuckerberg and family's Halloween transformation into Hogwarts icons warms hearts
items.summary_zh: 马克·扎克伯格和他的家人在 Instagram 上分享了一张万圣节照片，让粉丝们大饱眼福。照片中，一家人打扮成《哈利·波特》系列中的人物，扎克伯格扮演邓布利多，他的妻子扮演麦格教授。该图像得到了追随者的积极回应。扎克伯格还分享了一篇关于与女儿一起公路旅行去看古老红杉树的帖子。
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg and his family delighted fans by sharing a Halloween photo on Instagram. The picture showed the family dressed as characters from the Harry Potter series, with Zuckerberg as Dumbledore and his wife as Professor McGonagall. The image received a positive response from followers. Zuckerberg also shared a post about a road trip with his daughter to see ancient sequoia trees.

items.title_zh: 汽车司机唱歌“Bore hone ka opportunity-ich nahi”并招待困在安泰里交通中的人们
items.title_en: 'Bore hone ka chance-ich nahi' as auto driver sings & entertains people stuck in Andheri traffic
items.summary_zh: 病毒式新闻 新闻：新德里：孟买的交通永不停歇！这就像一个残酷的谜题，看不到明确的答案。
items.summary_en: Viral News News: NEW DELHI: The never-ending Mumbai traffic! It's like a cruel puzzle, with no clear solution in sight.
